persona.summary: Chinese private investment caster (900 staff, EUR 39.3 M); we are only 0.12 % of its turnover, a tiny account. Impeller HI 250 sells 6.5 % below its own full cost (repeatedly 'accepted below full cost to keep the volume'); 70180 holds 60 % as active co-source. Quality recovered to green (OTD 84 %, 0 ppm) after two red quarters. Few documents. Renewals settled 1.2-2.5 pts below its ask; little room to squeeze.
persona.notes: Needs to keep the volume it priced below cost to win. Fears losing the 40 % share to 70180. Only one generic 10-day payment e-mail; we pay nearly on time (1.9 days late).
fears: deeper losses on a part already below cost
